questions.q: What plague does Joel 1 describe devouring the land?
questions.evidence: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten

questions.q: On whom will Yahweh pour out his Spirit, Joel says?
questions.evidence: It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh

questions.q: In Joel 3, what are the plowshares to be beaten into?
questions.evidence: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears
